CITY OF SAN GABRIEL
  CITY COUNCIL
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA

  Tuesday, December 1, 2020 - 6:30 P.M.

  City Hall Council Chamber
  425 South Mission Drive
  San Gabriel, California 91776
  Due to Executive Order N-25-20 Members of the Council may
  Teleconference into the meeting.
  Denise Menchaca  Mark Lazzaretto
  Mayor  City Manager

  Chin Ho Liao  Keith Lemieux
  Vice Mayor  City Attorney

  Tony Ding  Julie Nguyen
  Council Member  City Clerk

  John R. Harrington  Kevin B. Sawkins
  Council Member  City Treasurer

  Jason Pu
  Council Member

Pursuant to State and County Directives, San Gabriel City Hall is closed to the public and physical access
to the meeting has been suspended. To provide members of the public access to the meeting and an
opportunity to comment on items on and off the Agenda, the following opportunities have been
established:

Public Comments

Please email all public comments to cityclerk@sgch.org and include the following on the subject line of
your email: the section (Public Comment, Consent, Public Hearing, New Business) and Item Number you
are commenting on. The Clerk will read public comments into the record for up to the three-minute limit.
Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and discriminatory language, will
not be read.
Example: PUBLIC COMMENT: New Business Item A
Watch the Meeting Online
Live broadcasts of the meetings are available using the following link:
City Council Meeting Videos
Spectrum cable: Live streaming on Channel 3, Public Access Channel.
   City Council Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, December 1, 2020

    CALL TO ORDER
    PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE LED BY: Council Member Ding
    ROLL CALL: Mayor Menchaca, Vice Mayor Liao, Council Members Ding,
  Harrington, Pu

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  2. PRESENTATIONS

  A. EMPLOYEE AWARDS
  B. COVID-19 BRIEFING

  3. PUBLIC COMMENT

  4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  All items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and
  recommendations will be approved in one motion unless a member of the
  City Council or audience requests separate discussion.

  A. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  This is the presentation of the “Register of Demands and Warrants” for the
  payment of City expenditures.

  Recommended Action: Approval.

  B. DEVELOPMENT IMPACT FEE COMPLIANCE REPORT REQUIRED
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §66006 FOR 2019 – 2020

  Pursuant to Government Code §66006, a local agency which levies a fee
  subject to Government Code Section §66006 shall make available to the
  public a report providing the information set forth in Government Code
  §66006(b)(1) and shall review that information at the next public meeting not
  less than 15 days after the information has been made available to the public.
  The report was prepared in compliance with the applicable Government Code
  sections and is hereby transmitted for City Council approval. The report was
  publicly available on the City’s website beginning November 9, 2020.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – December 1, 2020  2
   Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the attached Annual
  Development Impact Fee Compliance Report for Fiscal Year 2019-20 in
  accordance with Government Code §66006.

  C. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 20-64 AMENDING THE AUTHORIZED
  SALARY SCHEDULE TO COMPLY WITH THE CALIFORNIA MINIMUM
  WAGE REQUIREMENT EFFECTIVE JANUARY 1, 2021

  On January 1, 2021, the State minimum wage will increase to $14.00 per hour.
  To maintain compliance with State law, staff recommends salary increases for
  those positions classifications not meeting the new minimum wage and
  equity adjustments to those position classifications compacted by the new
  requirement.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-64 incorporating
  the new minimum wage and amending the City’s authorized salary schedule.

  D. EXTENSION OF ANIMAL CARE AND CONTROL SERVICES AGREEMENT
  WITH THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY HUMANE SOCIETY IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $175,000

  At the City Council meeting of October 27, 2020, staff provided an update on
  the research on alternatives for providing animal control services to the City,
  and shared new proposals from the San Gabriel Valley Humane Society that
  provided a significant cost savings for City Council’s consideration. City
  Council provided new direction to staff, and staff was to return to City Council
  to exercise the six-month extension option in the current Animal Care and
  Control Agreement while continuing to implement Council’s direction. This
  item is for consideration of the six-month extension at a cost of $175,000,
  with the City retaining approximately $28,000 in animal licensing fees.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that City Council approve the amendment to the Animal
  Care and Control Services Agreement.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – December 1, 2020  3
   E. 410 MCGROARTY STREET FILIMING AND FACILITIES USE AGREEMENT

  A film production company is interested in using 410 McGroarty, a City facility
  warehouse, for filming an indie film in January 2021. This production is in
  association with the Russo brothers, of Marvel fame, and the opportunity can
  translate to financial support of a local business, improvement to a City
  facility, and ways to advertise San Gabriel as a film friendly city in the industry,
  and attract future film opportunities.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve the filming and facilities use
  agreement for 410 McGroarty and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  agreement.

  F. COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) CARES ACT
  FUNDED PROGRAMS UPDATE AND OPTIONS

  The City of San Gabriel has been allocated $186,148 in Community
  Development Block Grant (CDBG) CARES Act funding, which per Council’s
  direction, allocated funding to the City’s senior meals program, and created
  two new programs; a Housing Relief Grant Program and the Small Business
  Grant Program. This item provides an update on these programs, and
  recommends that unspent Housing Relief Grant Program funds be
  reallocated to the Small Business Grant Program.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve the shift of $61,000 in
  remaining funds from the Housing Relief Program to the Small Business Grant
  Program.

  Alternatively, the City Council may choose to:

    Allocate $40,000 of the remaining funds to the Small Business Grant
  Program (16 grants) and $21,000 to the Senior Meals Program, or
    Consider other alternative amounts to allocate to either/both the Small
  Business Grant Program and the Senior Meals Program, or

    Provide other direction to staff

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – December 1, 2020  4
   G. APPROVAL OF FINAL MAP AND SUBDIVISION IMPROVEMENT
  AGREEMENT FOR TRACT NO. 72531 (PROPOSED MIXED-USE
  DEVELOPMENT AT 704-712 WEST LAS TUNAS DRIVE “MISSION VIEW”)

  This development, located at 704 Las Tunas Drive, is a three-story mixed-use
  development with approximately 16,549 square feet of commercial space and
  37 residential condominium units on an 82,295 square feet site. Staff and the
  City’s contract consultant for land surveying, RKA Consulting Group, Inc., have
  reviewed the Final Tract Map and determined it is in compliance with the State
  Subdivision Map Act, conditions of approval, and the City’s ordinances
  regarding subdivisions and condominiums.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve the Final Tract Map No.
  72531 and the Subdivision Improvement Agreement and authorize its filing
  with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

  5. PUBLIC HEARING – None.

  6. NEW BUSINESS – None.

  7. PUBLIC COMMENT

  8. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

  9. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Each Council Member may address the City Council and public on matters of
  general information and/or concern. This is also the time for Council Members
  to report on conferences and/or meetings they have attended.

  10. CLOSED SESSION – None.

  11. ADJOURNMENT

  The next Regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, December 15,
  2020, at 6:30 p.m. Information regarding matters to be considered at each
  meeting will be available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the
  City’s website at www.sangabrielcity.com.

MINUTES OF DECEMBER 1, 2020
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

CALL TO ORDER

Mayor Menchaca called the regular meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at
6:51 P.M. on Tuesday, December 1, 2020, with all Council Members and staff participating
by teleconference.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION (GOVERNMENT CODE
§54956.9) Sam et al. v. City of San Gabriel

City Attorney Lemieux reported that in the Closed Session Special Meeting immediately
preceding this meeting, the City Council received a report from Special Counsel; no
reportable action was taken.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Council Member Ding.

ROLL CALL

Council Members Present:  Tony Ding, John R. Harrington, Jason Pu, Vice Mayor
  Chin Ho Liao, and Mayor Denise Menchaca.
Council Members Absent:  None.
Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, Assistant City
  Manager/Community Development Director Arminé
  Chaparyan, City Attorney Keith Lemieux, Community
  Services/Interim Mission Playhouse Director Rebecca
  Perez, Police Chief Eugene Harris, Chief City Clerk
  Sharon Clark, Public Works Director/City Engineer Greg
  de Vinck, Fire Chief Steven Wallace, Human
  Resources/Risk Management Director Edward Macias,
  Interim Finance Director Kenneth Louie, and Assistant
  City Clerk Marilyn Bonus.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Chief City Clerk Clark provided information for the public on how to view the meeting and
submit comments, and how to request meeting agendas.

1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  Hearing no objection, Mayor Menchaca announced the agenda order was approved.

2. PRESENTATIONS

  A. EMPLOYEE AWARDS
CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 1 of 4  December 1, 2020
   The Employee Service Awards presentation was made by Mayor Menchaca and the
  Employee Recognition Awards presentation was made by City Manager Lazzaretto.

  B. COVID-19 BRIEFING

  The presentation was made by Fire Chief Wallace and Police Chief Harris.

3. PUBLIC COMMENT

  Sean McMorris, resident, provided comments advocating for the employment of
  formal contracts for City out-sourced services and expressing disagreement with the
  City Council’s rationale in the recent award of non-exclusive towing franchises.

4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  Regarding Item 4F, Sandy Rosco, Executive Director of the San Gabriel Chamber of
  Commerce provided comments requesting the City Council’s aid in retaining outdoor
  dining for San Gabriel restaurants.

  A motion was made by Vice Mayor Liao, seconded by Council Member Pu, to approve
  Consent Calendar Items 4A – 4G as presented.

  Motion approved Consent Calendar Items 4A – 4G as presented by a vote of 5-0 as
  follows:

  AYES:  DING, HARRINGTON, PU, LIAO, MENCHACA
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  NONE

  A. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  The City Council approved the November 5, 2020, and November 13, 2020,
  Registers of Demands and Warrants for the payment of City expenditures.

  B. DEVELOPMENT IMPACT FEE COMPLIANCE REPORT REQUIRED PURSUANT TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE §66006 FOR 2019 – 2020

  The City Council received and filed the Annual Development Impact Fee
  Compliance Report for Fiscal Year 2019-20 in accordance with Government Code
  §66006.

  C. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 20-64 AMENDING THE AUTHORIZED
  SALARY SCHEDULE TO COMPLY WITH THE CALIFORNIA MINIMUM WAGE
  REQUIREMENT EFFECTIVE JANUARY 1, 2021

  The City Council adopted Resolution No. 20-64 incorporating the new minimum
  wage and amending the City’s authorized salary schedule.

  D. EXTENSION OF ANIMAL CARE AND CONTROL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH
  THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY HUMANE SOCIETY IN THE AMOUNT OF $175,000

  The City Council approved the amendment to the Animal Care and Control Services
  Agreement, to extend the agreement for six months at a cost of $175,000, with the
  City retaining approximately $28,000 in animal licensing fees.

CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 2 of 4  December 1, 2020
   E. 410 MCGROARTY STREET FILIMING AND FACILITIES USE AGREEMENT

  The City Council approved the filming and facilities use agreement for 410
  McGroarty and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement.

  F. COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) CARES ACT FUNDED
  PROGRAMS UPDATE AND OPTIONS

  The City Council approved the re-allocation of $61,000 in remaining funds from
  the Housing Relief Program to the Small Business Grant Program.

  G. APPROVAL OF FINAL MAP AND SUBDIVISION IMPROVEMENT AGREEMENT
  FOR TRACT NO. 72531 (PROPOSED MIXED-USE DEVELOPMENT AT 704-712
  WEST LAS TUNAS DRIVE “MISSION VIEW”)

  The City Council approved Final Tract Map No. 72531 and the Subdivision
  Improvement Agreement and authorized filing with the Los Angeles County
  Recorder.

5. PUBLIC HEARING – None.

6. NEW BUSINESS – None.

7. PUBLIC COMMENT – None.

8. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

  City Manager Lazzaretto wished everyone a happy kickoff to the holiday season, and
  received a consensus of the City Council to cancel the January 5, 2021, regular City
  Council meeting.

9. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Vice Mayor Liao reported on his attendance of the virtual Southern California
  Association of Governments (SCAG) Economic Summit.

  Council Member Pu reported on a meeting of the Southern California Council of
  Governments (COG) Transportation Committee, and on a METRO amendment to
  Measure R and Measure M Highway Program criteria.

  Council Member Ding expressed his desire to find grant funding to help San Gabriel
  restaurants during the COVID restrictions.

  Mayor Menchaca announced a meeting of the Human Equity, Access and Relations
  (HEAR) Commission ad hoc committee on December 3, 2020, at 6:30 P.M.; announced
  that the first virtual holiday tree lighting video is available on the City’s YouTube
  Channel; and detailed Community Services Department upcoming holiday events.

10. CLOSED SESSION – None.

11. ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Menchaca adjourned the meeting at 7:56 P.M.

Respectfully submitted:
